description: This file is a FastAPI router module for handling GDPR-related API endpoints, including creating GDPR requests (export or delete) and processing delete requests (admin only). It defines API routes, database interactions, audit logging, and data export functions related to GDPR compliance.

methods.name: None _audit( db: Session, *, actor_user_id: UUID | None, action: str, entity_type: str | None = None, entity_id: UUID | None = None, ip: str | None = None, ua: str | None = None, metadata: dict | None = None, )
methods.description: Logs audit entries for specified actions, including user actions and system modifications.

methods.name: dict _export_user_data(db: Session, user_id: UUID)
methods.description: Exports user-related data from multiple tables for GDPR data export requests.

methods.name: GDPRRequestResponse create_gdpr_request( req: GDPRRequestCreate, request: Request, user: UserMe = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Endpoint to create a GDPR request, supports export and delete types, triggers data export immediately for exports.

methods.name: GDPRRequestResponse process_delete_request( request_id: UUID, request: Request, admin: UserMe = Depends(require_admin), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Admin-only endpoint to process a delete GDPR request by removing a user and associated data, marking the request as completed.
